blurb: Guests join a 90-minute guided cruise aboard the SS Bigwin, a beautifully restored 1910 steamship. Cruises depart from Dorset or Dwight and glide through Trading Bay, past century-old lodges and the pristine Muskoka shoreline. The experience includes narrated heritage cruises and options for private charters and sunset cruises.
